newsitem.title: GERMANY: Fund outflows from Germany rose in March - Buba.
newsitem.headline: Fund outflows from Germany rose in March - Buba.

text.p: Germany sustained a net outflow of funds in cross-border securities trade in March, the Bundesbank said on Friday.
Foreign investors pulled a net total of 11.6 billion marks out of the country, up from February's 6.6 billion marks, the central bank said.
Foreign investors sold a net 1.3 billion marks worth of German securities compared with net purchases of 9.9 billion marks in February.
German investors in March bought foreign securities worth 10.4 bilion marks in March, down from February's 16.5 billion.
The Bundesbank said domestic investors had shown particular interest in foreign shares, but had also invested in mark denominated foreign bonds.
Direct investment by German firms abroad accounted for capital exports of 4.1 billion marks in March versus 2.4 billion in February.
